text.characters: Answer 3 quick questions. Choose at least one option for each.
Which specific symptom or behaviour related to dementia caregiving do you find most challenging and want to learn how to manage?
Hallucinations (seeing or hearing things when no one else has) or Delusions (fixed, false beliefs that conflict with reality)
Repetitive behaviours (abnormal behaviour characterized by repetition, rigidity, and lack of adaptability)
Poor or decreased judgment and decision-making
